deficiencies.description: The lecturer refers to a specific case ('this meningioma') that occurred within the skull and exerted pressure on the brain. The rewrite generalizes this into a broad claim that a meningioma occurs within the skull and puts an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and surrounding structures.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this meningioma obviously is occurring within the skull. The skull is a confined space. This would put an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A meningioma occurs within the skull, which is a confined space, so it puts an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures

considerations.sourcePassage: Obviously, when there is a suspicion of cancer or of a tumor, everybody gets very nervous about what that diagnosis is going to look like.
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders this as 'When cancer or a tumour is suspected, there is considerable anxiety about the diagnosis', which conveys the same meaning while removing colloquial phrasing.

considerations.sourcePassage: the smooth muscle fibroid that I showed you, that almost never progresses to a leiomyosarcoma.
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders 'that I showed you' as 'as shown earlier, almost never progresses to a leiomyosarcoma. [FIGURE]', which is an allowed stylistic phrasing and figure reference.

considerations.sourcePassage: So things like meningiomas can cause that.
considerations.reason: 'Meningiomas can therefore have this effect' carries the same meaning as the source statement.
